title: City of Laredo Wishes Residents a Happy Thanksgiving; Offices Closed Thursday and Friday
excerpt: The City of Laredo wished residents a happy Thanksgiving and said city administrative offices will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, 2026, for the holiday.
content:
The City of Laredo wished residents a happy Thanksgiving on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, and said city administrative offices will be closed on Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, 2026, in observance of the holiday.

The city said Thanksgiving celebrates the spirit of gratitude, togetherness, and community that makes Laredo a special place to call home, and wished residents and their loved ones a wonderful Thanksgiving filled with joy, warmth, and cherished moments.
